senses.en_definition: To cause amazement, admiration, or wonder.

messages.en: I just sent you some photos. The scenery here is absolutely stunning—the photos don't even do it justice!
It's gorgeous! Where did you take that photo? Just looking at it makes me want to go.

senses.en_definition: To frighten or intimidate someone, or deter them through fear.
To fear or worry that something may happen, especially in the impersonal form ditakutkan.

collocations.en: it is feared that it may rain
it is feared that it may happen

messages.en: That film was so scary. I even closed my eyes during that hospital scene.
Me too! Good thing we watched it together. If I'd been on my own, I would've stopped watching.
Let's just watch a comedy next time, okay? I want to sleep properly tonight.

senses.en_definition: To achieve victory in a contest, war, or competition; to defeat an opponent.
Money or other rewards gained from winning, especially in gambling.
To win a prize or award in a competition; also, to pass an examination.
To be at least equal to, or better than, someone or something in a particular respect.

messages.en: We won! Let's go get something to eat. My treat.
You're really treating me? I'm getting two plates of chicken rice, then.
Sure! You scored that goal, after all!

senses.en_definition: To shed tears or sob as an expression of sadness or another strong emotion.

messages.en: I thought I was okay, but when I went back and read his messages, I started crying again.
If you need to cry, just let it out. You don't have to force yourself to be okay. Want me to call?
Yes. Can you keep me company for a bit? I don't want to be alone right now.
